name: TeamStarWolf - DentaQuest Health-Data Breach May 2026 Case Study
description: Curated case-study layer, not an official MITRE mapping. Enterprise ATT&CK v20.0 techniques bound in the DentaQuest health-data breach case study, from the social engineering of one employee for credentials and an MFA code on 17 May 2026 through the file-share theft to 19 May and the extortion claim. No source names ATT&CK ids, so every binding is the study's own reading. Score 100: a primary states the behavior and the technique fits directly. Score 60: a primary states the behavior and the fit is partial. Score 40: the behavior is known only from the actor's claim or Reported sources. Scores measure the strength of the tie to this record, not severity. No malware, exfiltration channel or lure sub-technique is in the record, so none is bound. Comments carry the study's source numbers.
